# examples/

Worked end-to-end session walkthroughs showing the kit handling common bill patterns, including a single-encounter dispute, a multi-encounter months-long process, an ERISA insurance-denial appeal, and a small-claims escalation, using synthetic patient data throughout.

<!-- BEGIN CONTENTS (auto-generated, do not edit by hand) -->

- [multi_encounter_walkthrough.md](multi_encounter_walkthrough.md): A patient with bills from two distinct hospital encounters, processed across three sessions over six weeks.
- [small_claims_walkthrough.md](small_claims_walkthrough.md): A patient files in small claims court against a hospital that ignored a documented dispute.
- [walkthrough.md](walkthrough.md): A synthetic patient walking through one full session with the kit loaded into an LLM.
